headline: When Should You Consider Hardwired Bathroom Night Lights?
articleBody:
While plug-in night lights are convenient, there are definite times when hardwired bathroom night lights are the superior choice. If you’re looking for a seamless, integrated, and more permanent solution that truly enhances your bathroom’s functionality and safety, hardwired options often make more sense. It’s about creating a cohesive lighting plan that works effortlessly.

One clear signal to consider hardwired night lights is during a larger bathroom remodel. When walls are already open for other electrical or plumbing work, it's significantly easier and more cost-effective to run new wiring for dedicated night lights. It saves you from having to reopen walls later or deal with unsightly cords.

Another reason is when you want more control and advanced features. Hardwired night lights can be easily tied into existing bathroom circuits, allowing for more sophisticated control through dimmers or motion sensors. This gives you the flexibility to adjust brightness levels or have lights automatically activate when you enter the room, providing hands-free convenience.

If you're aiming for a clean, minimalist aesthetic, hardwired is the way to go. They can be discreetly installed under vanities, along toe kicks, or in recessed wall fixtures, blending seamlessly into the design. No more bulky plug-ins taking up outlets or looking out of place.

Finally, for installations in moisture-exposed locations, such as near a shower or tub, hardwired lights often offer better safety and durability when properly installed and rated for damp or wet conditions.
